Use case: precise-object-edit
The reference is the EXACT ORIGINAL Silent Storm full square64x64 particle animation frame, enlarged8x by nearest neighbor from native RGB ONLY. The helper adds no art. Native TransparentAdd alpha is uniformly0 with useful original RGB; this opaque support only exposes those native channels. Root final pack restores original alpha0.
Edit the ORIGINAL into a faithful smooth HD painted particle effect while preserving EVERY original normalized UV coordinate, occupied footprint, contour/holes/notches, connected and separated source component/tip/fleck counts, exact relative size, source-scale internal dark/light paint regions, materials, source shades and soft gradients. Return one complete square frame on black, never a scene, photo,3D render, atlas or sprite sheet. NO crop, zoom, recenter, shift, rotation, repacking, extra border or margin. Full black source canvas remains, even if the painted core is tiny.
Resolve coarse pixels into the same restrained smooth source painting. Keep original plain soft diffuse fire/flash material and broad source tonal patches, without decorative fine patterns. Do NOT add new curl, tendril, fractal noise, filament, ray, luminous crack, smoke swirl, sharp glint, extra tongue, spike, detached puff, ember/fleck, star, sparkle, trail, ring, stone/rock/clump or object. Existing source contour tips/marks keep EXACT original number, width, size and source location; do not multiply or sharpen them into glowing rays. Do not turn weak brown source marks into white/yellow points. Never connect source-separated patches or cut new holes into a connected source core. Avoid photoreal turbulence and cartoon cauliflower smoke; do not add new internal lobes or ridges.
Preserve original muted brown/orange/lavender/pale white hues, original soft fades and low contrast. Do not brighten the core or invent white highlights/relighting. Dark source areas remain dark and softly blended. No dark outline around original translucent paint and no sharpening a fuzzy source boundary into a hard cutout edge. Keep weak little source marks at their original weak intensity. Numeric brightness correction occurs later. No text, symbols, logo or new border.
Source-specific constraints: This64x64 Fire01 original is one orange flame mass in the center with the original large black upper-left hole and smaller mid/lower channels. Keep exactly its source upper forks, bright central mass, right falling wisps, original lower-left connected tongue and dark bottom fading tips. No new curls or tendrils inside the broad source areas.
